title: Embedding a word configuration
statement: Fix Boolean machines $E$ and $G$, a Boolean input word $x$, and a state $q$ of $E$. If $E$ has at least one work tape, then for every Boolean word $s$, embedding the configuration on input $x$ with state $q$ and with $s$ on tape $0$ (all other tapes empty) into $\max(k_E,k_G)$ work tapes, using the corresponding left-call state, gives the configuration on input $x$ with that left-call state and with $s$ on tape $0$ (all other tapes empty).
hypotheses_covered: $E$ has a positive number of work tapes
